name: Shizukuishi (Japan)
description: A maroon field charged at the centre with the Shizukuishi town emblem in white: an outlined ring enclosing a stylised droplet.
history: Municipal flag of Shizukuishi, a town in Iwate Prefecture; like most Japanese municipal flags it shows the municipal emblem on a plain field. The municipal emblem was adopted on 1 April 1965.

features.role: Shizukuishi town emblem — an outlined ring enclosing a stylised droplet
